INSERT INTO keynote_speakers (
  full_name,
  title,
  affiliation,
  affiliation_ar,
  photo_url,
  bio,
  bio_ar,
  presentation_title,
  presentation_title_ar,
  abstract_text,
  abstract_text_ar,
  speaker_type,
  display_order,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  'Dr. Ahmed Fikry El-Sayed',
  'Ph.D. – Molecular Biotechnologist',
  'Assistant Professor of Computational Biochemistry, King Salman International University',
  'أستاذ مساعد الكيمياء الحيوية الحاسوبية، جامعة الملك سلمان الدولية',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/118031311/TbmaCrtrtyaJjSsm.png',
  'Dr. Ahmed Fikry El-Sayed is a specialist in molecular genetics and bioinformatics. He holds a Ph.D. in Molecular Genetics from Al-Azhar University in Cairo and works as an Assistant Professor in the Biotechnology Research Institute, National Research Centre, Giza, Egypt. He also worked as a Clinical Bioinformatician on the Egypt Genome Project, at the Egypt Center for Research and Regenerative Medicine (ECRRM). He is currently working as an Assistant Professor of Computational Biochemistry at the Faculty of Basic Sciences – Biotechnology Program, at King Salman International University. Dr. El-Sayed''s work lies with his unparalleled expertise in genetic variant analysis. He excels in tertiary analysis, expertly interpreting complex genetic data to uncover insights into disease mechanisms and therapeutic potential. His proficiency in in-silico prediction of variant pathogenicity empowers precise identification of genetic risks, paving the way for personalized medicine. Dr. El-Sayed is a master of large-scale genomic studies, conducting genome-wide association studies (GWAS), pharmacogenomic analyses, and population genetics research. These efforts illuminate the genetic underpinnings of diseases and drug responses, offering hope for tailored treatments and improved patient outcomes. Dr. El-Sayed harnesses computational tools to unlock the secrets of life at a molecular level. His skills encompass: Genome Annotation, Computer-Aided Drug Discovery, Protein Structure Prediction, Molecular Modeling and Docking, and Dynamics Simulation. Dr. El-Sayed has over 70 peer-reviewed publications in high-impact journals, in drug discovery and in-silico analysis.',
  'د. أحمد فكري السيد متخصص في علم الوراثة الجزيئية والمعلوماتية الحيوية. حاصل على درجة الدكتوراه في علم الوراثة الجزيئية من جامعة الأزهر بالقاهرة ويعمل أستاذًا مساعدًا في معهد بحوث التكنولوجيا الحيوية بالمركز القومي للبحوث بالجيزة، مصر. عمل أيضًا كأخصائي معلوماتية حيوية إكلينيكية في مشروع الجينوم المصري بالمركز المصري للبحوث والطب التجديدي. يعمل حاليًا أستاذًا مساعدًا للكيمياء الحيوية الحاسوبية بكلية العلوم الأساسية - برنامج التكنولوجيا الحيوية بجامعة الملك سلمان الدولية.',
  'Computer-Aided Drug Design: From Code to Cure',
  'تصميم الأدوية بمساعدة الحاسوب: من البرمجة إلى العلاج',
  'The traditional drug discovery process faces major challenges because it requires expensive operations while taking long periods to complete with many projects failing during development. The field experiences complete transformation because scientists now practice purposeful drug development instead of their previous random screening approach. The pharmaceutical industry experiences a revolutionary transformation because Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD) drives the process which starts with programming and reaches medical treatment development. The basic principles of structure-based and ligand-based drug design receive our attention through methods which include molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, pharmacophore modeling, and quantitative structure-activity relationships (QSAR). The research investigates how artificial intelligence and machine learning systems have transformed scientific approaches to predict ADMET properties and they can now explore large chemical databases at high speed. The process of hit identification becomes faster through CADD, which also improves lead compound optimization and development pipeline risk reduction to create a new system for turning genetic data and computer programs into medical treatments which save lives.',
  'تواجه عملية اكتشاف الأدوية التقليدية تحديات كبيرة لأنها تتطلب عمليات باهظة الثمن بينما تستغرق فترات طويلة لإكمالها مع فشل العديد من المشاريع أثناء التطوير. يشهد المجال تحولاً كاملاً لأن العلماء يمارسون الآن تطوير الأدوية الهادف بدلاً من نهج الفحص العشوائي السابق. تشهد صناعة الأدوية تحولاً ثورياً لأن تصميم الأدوية بمساعدة الحاسوب (CADD) يقود العملية التي تبدأ بالبرمجة وتصل إلى تطوير العلاج الطبي.',
  'invited',
  2,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
